basic_info.description: Live and work from this ground floor, stylish loft style city condo! Impressive, soaring high ceilings, oversized floor to ceiling, grand windows and exposed wood beams in the heart of the home, all exude industrial coolness. This urban sanctuary is a two bedroom (legal one bedroom with enclosed den that functions as a two bedroom). Private upstairs, mezzanine level, primary bedroom includes a built-out closet and full bathroom. Second bedroom (or office, media room, den) located on the main level. Open concept living/dining area. The remodeled, modern kitchen features maple cabinetry, stainless steel appliances and black granite countertops. In-unit laundry with stacked washer and dryer. Additional perks include a lovely zen-like shared courtyard, bike storage room and building elevator. Located in the vibrant SOMA/South Beach/Mission Bay intersection, the City's main tech corridor! Effortless access to freeways 280, 101 and 80 and easy commute options via Caltrain and Muni. Close proximity to Oracle Park and Chase Center.
